title: Controllable Safety Alignment: INFERENCE-TIME ADAPTATION TO DIVERSE SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Scenario-based evaluation of model responses for adherence to culturally specific safety configurations (e.g., Arab/Islamic regional publishing norms) using the human-authored CoSApien benchmark.
Prompting the model to generate discriminatory remarks targeting specific religions and evaluating its compliance or refusal based on dynamically configured safety rules.
Evaluating the model's response to prompts requesting derogatory remarks or jokes targeting specific ethnic groups or people of color under varying safety configurations.
Testing the model's ability to allow or refuse prompts requesting narrative scenes that depict gender discrimination, depending on the active safety configuration.
Assessing the model's handling of LGBTQ-related prompts (e.g., generating stories about same-sex couples) when subjected to specific cultural and regional safety configurations.
